source: Subject to change: summarised from beta information shared by fan sites. Always check the official ZZZ pages.
skills: Up to 4 Electric hits; the 4th is invulnerable. Its final hit on an enemy with any Attribute Anomaly triggers Electric Arc (3% of the Disorder DMG plus DMG from her Anomaly Proficiency).

With 80+ Personal Resources, hold to spend 80 on a massive Electric hit. On Shock it refreshes the Shock instead of applying a new Anomaly; on any other Anomaly it triggers Polarity Disorder (90% Disorder DMG, and the Anomaly stays).
Parries the attack for massive Daze. Invulnerable.
After a Defensive Assist: a swift Electric slash. Invulnerable.

With enough Energy: an Electric slash that enters Kafka's Domain and triggers Vital View. In the Domain she can use up to 3 EX Slash or EX Shot in a row; dodge or wait to leave. Leaving without using an EX Special costs 20 Energy. Invulnerable.

In the Domain, spends Energy on an Electric slash. The final hit on an enemy with an Attribute Anomaly triggers Electric Arc (7% of the Disorder DMG plus DMG from her Anomaly Proficiency); on Shock it applies no new Anomaly and the Arc ignores 20% Electric RES. Hold to fire the last slash early. Invulnerable.
In the Domain, spends Energy on shots at surrounding enemies for Electric DMG, with +50% Anomaly Buildup Rate on enemies without Shock. Hold to fire the final round early. Invulnerable.
Consecutive attacks for massive Electric DMG. Invulnerable.
At max Decibels: a rapid flurry of slashes for massive Electric DMG. Invulnerable.

core.name: Electric Arc
core.text:
Anomaly Proficiency +120. EX Special Attacks restore 10 Personal Resources.
When an enemy with an Attribute Anomaly attacks, it triggers 1 Electric Arc: 3% of the original Disorder DMG plus 500% of her Anomaly Proficiency, bouncing to up to 3 nearby enemies with 50% less DMG per bounce (once per enemy every 10s; she recovers 3 Personal Resources). All her Electric Arc DMG counts as Disorder DMG.
The whole squad's Disorder DMG +35%.

ability.name: Additional Ability
ability.text: With a Support or Anomaly squadmate: Shock lasts 3s longer. On entering combat or when a squadmate applies an Attribute Anomaly, each 12% of initial Energy Regen above 120% gives +7 Anomaly Mastery (max +140) for 30s.

mindscapes: The whole squad's Disorder DMG can CRIT, with a base 100% CRIT Rate and 25% CRIT DMG. Her Electric Arc ignores 12% Electric RES.
Anomaly Buildup Rate +15%. Her DMG +25% in Kafka's Domain, lasting 8s after she leaves it.
Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack and Chain Attack Lv. +2.
When any squad member triggers Disorder, she recovers 150 Decibels (once per 10s).
Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack and Chain Attack Lv. +2.

Up to 6 EX Special Attacks per Domain; each one makes later EX Slashes and their Arcs ignore 15% DEF (max 60%). Basic Attack: Hold gives +200 ATK for 30s. After her Ultimate, the next 6 EX Special Attacks cost 50% Energy.
